title.zh: 【Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，合并后团队将以「Formation」名义运营】
title.en: 【Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，合并后团队将以「Formation」名义运营】

current_state.zh: Solana liquidity protocol Orca and on-chain lending protocol Loopscale have completed a merger and will operate under the new name Formation, led by Loopscale co-founder Luke Truitt as CEO, combining trading/liquidity infrastructure with credit and custody infrastructure to offer assets an end-to-end path from issuance to financing and liquidity.
current_state.en: Solana liquidity protocol Orca and on-chain lending protocol Loopscale have completed a merger and will operate under the new name Formation, led by Loopscale co-founder Luke Truitt as CEO, combining trading/liquidity infrastructure with credit and custody infrastructure to offer assets an end-to-end path from issuance to financing and liquidity.
